main_text.p: Cum cartilagine quoq; cognationem habent Ligamenta, ofsibus circa junctūras annata, eaque firmissimè colligantia.
Heterogeneæ autem partes horum animalium, quæ ex homogeneis componuntur: aliæ sunt carno-sæ, aliæ ossea[?].
Heterogeneæ partes carnosæ ex carnibus constituitur[?], fibris instar filorum tenacibus & oblongis connexis.
Ejusmodi sunt cum membranæ & membranosæ partes; tum viscera & musculi.
Membrana est pars carnosa ac lenta, partes alias quasi panniculus integens.
Membranosæ partes sunt, Ventriculus, œsophagus, & intestina: item Vesicæ, venæ, arteriæ & nervi.
Ventriculus est pars membranosa, alimento excipiendo, & primo concoquendo destinata.
Oesophagus est pars ventriculo superius annata, alimentum ex ore in ventriculum deducens.
Intestina sunt partes inferius ventriculo annatæ, alimentum in ventriculo primâ coctione præparatum (Chylum vocant) excipientes.
Horum superiora chylum retinent, donec in epar trahatur: inferiora, primæ concoctionis excrementa (Stercora dicta) expellunt.
Vesica est pars membranosa, firmiter compacta, excipiendis excrementis secundæ concoctionis, quæ in epate fit (felli sc. & urinæ) destinata.

page.notes: Printed page number "63" at top right is set in a slightly different size; read as 63. The signature "E 4" is at the foot right. Long s throughout printed as s. Word "constituitur" is uncertain (hyphenated line break "confti-tuutur"), and "ossea" in the line "aliæ ofsea" is marked [?]. The word "epate" is printed as such. Stains and a faint show-through at the top of the page were ignored.
